optionMeanings: 基于某个字段把数据分散到多个数据库，每个分片只处理一部分数据
所有写都去一个数据库，无法扩展
写请求到缓存代替数据库
optionScenarioImpacts: 每个分片处理一部分写负载，可以线性扩展写吞吐
主库过载，写吞吐有上限
缓存无法代替数据库持久化
optionMeanings_en: Distribute data across multiple databases by key; each shard handles portion of data
All writes go one database; cannot scale
Route writes to cache instead of database
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Each shard handles portion of write load; can scale linearly
optionDirectness_en: Sharding basic technique for write scaling

optionMeanings: 把高并发写集中进队列，由单worker顺序处理，避免并发争
所有写并发直接到数据库，互相竞争
optionScenarioImpacts: 对超热点数据，队列化消除竞争，系统更稳定但吞吐被worker限制
并发写争争抢抢，系统不稳定
optionDirectness: 队列化是热点数据的有效方案
optionMeanings_en: Concentrate high-concurrency writes into queue; single worker processes sequentially to avoid contention
All writes concurrent directly to database; compete with each other
Do not handle concurrent write conflicts
optionScenarioImpacts_en: For super hot data, queuing eliminates contention, system stable but worker limits throughput
